Chapter 1: The Misty Vale

Centuries after the hero Eledain banished the demon Sathmog and founded a dragon-worshipping empire, the immortal sorcerer Azrahel Koth has woken in his crypt beneath the Isle of Mist, and a corrupting fog lies over the Misty Vale. Crossing the Drakmar Pass into the valley, the adventurers find the cultist Drigel Weatherman dying from a goblin's black arrow; he presses a bundle on them and gasps of Leanara and the secret of the dragon emperor before Maladûk's goblin scouts and their worg-riding commander strike. Inside are a map of the vale and the first of four pieces of Eledain's statuette, the key to the crypt of the dragon-slaying sword Um-Durman beneath Outskirt. Cultists, orcs and dragon knights all hunt the pieces; only with the sword can the heroes pierce the mist and end Azrahel Koth.

4 scenes · 4 stat blocks · 2 maps · 3 treasure
